tasks.approved_by: Founder approval in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-10-30
scope: Investigate failures in configured PadippuPal CI and test workflows.
Prepare focused repairs only when they are necessary to satisfy an already-approved roadmap task's acceptance criteria.
Run the relevant regression checks and create a reviewable pull request.
non_goals: Invent or implement new product features.
Change curriculum or learner-facing behavior outside an approved task.
Merge pull requests, deploy production, write production data, perform destructive migrations, or publish releases.
acceptance_criteria: Every repair links to the originating failed workflow run and exact tested SHA.
A confirmed root cause and regression test are recorded before a repair is proposed.
No more than five distinct repair generations are attempted for one originating failure; generation five failure escalates.
All changes are isolated in branches and submitted as pull requests.
Required checks run against the exact proposed commit and no assertions are weakened or tests skipped.

tasks.approved_by: Founder explicitly approved unified Engineering Operating System + AutoPilot integration in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-10-30
scope: Align the canonical Proceed trigger, AGENTS.md, Engineering AutoPilot documentation, CI automation documentation, approved-work ledger and active-work handoff so Engineering OS and AutoPilot operate together on the same task.
Define one shared task-selection, approval/evidence, execution, retest, acceptance and handoff cycle using existing repository structures.
State the actual capability boundary: GitHub AutoPilot is a CI recorder and deterministic policy validator; session execution uses available connected tools and is not unattended AI code repair.
non_goals: Create a second agent, service, dashboard, workflow family, task database or competing source of truth.
Add Codex, paid model integrations or unattended AI code-writing workers.
Change learner-facing product behavior, curriculum content or production data.
Merge PRs automatically, deploy production, perform destructive migrations or publish public releases.
acceptance_criteria: One founder command, Proceed, invokes the canonical Engineering OS + AutoPilot sequence; no second prompt or separate trigger is required.
Engineering OS owns whole-project context recovery, priority selection, the single active task and acceptance review.
AutoPilot applies exact task approval, CI evidence, root-cause, five-generation and retest controls to that same task.
Both roles share one task ID, branch/PR, investigation trail and active-work handoff.
GitHub workflow and tool capability limitations are stated accurately; no unattended repair or durable cross-run counter is falsely claimed.
Existing policy validation and unit tests pass on the exact proposed commit; no learner-facing or production behavior changes.

tasks.approved_by: Founder approval in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-10-30
scope: Extend the existing PadippuPal AutoPilot workflow with one deterministic full-cycle controller.
Dispatch the existing guidance, curriculum, Android APK, deployed read-only API smoke, and Android UI smoke workflows in a fixed order.
Poll each exact branch/SHA workflow run at one-minute intervals with bounded discovery and execution timeouts.
Continue to later independent checks after an earlier stage fails and publish one consolidated result.
Add deterministic tests for workflow ordering, failure continuation, and release safety.
non_goals: Create a second workflow family, agent, service, task queue, or ledger.
Add Codex or a paid model integration.
Invent or apply arbitrary source-code repairs or blindly retry unchanged failures.
Merge pull requests, deploy production, write production data, run destructive migrations, or publish releases.
acceptance_criteria: A single full-cycle workflow dispatch coordinates all five existing checks on the selected branch and exact SHA.
The controller sleeps 60 seconds between status checks and uses bounded run-discovery and stage timeouts.
A failed, timed-out, or undiscoverable stage does not suppress later independent checks.
The final controller result is non-success if any stage is not successful.
The Android workflow is always dispatched with publish_release=false.
Unit tests cover stage ordering, continuation after failure, and release safety.
Documentation clearly states that arbitrary code repair and ChatGPT-to-GitHub workflow dispatch are not yet available.
